                                ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BYTHE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I . Title 17, ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-G in the area bounded by


       West 19'*^ Place Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to South Racine
       Avenue; a line 27.94 feet south of and parallel to West 19"^ Place; and
       South Racine Avenue,


to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common Address of Property:          1925 South Racine Avenue
                               CITY OF CIIICAGO
                     APPLICATION FOR AN AMENDMENT TO
                      THE CIIICAGO ZONING ORDINANCE

7.    On what date did the ovvner acquire legal title to the subject property? December. 2020

8.    Has the present owner previously rezoned this property? If Yes, when? No

9.    Present Zoning District: Cl-2                       Proposed Zoning District: B2-3

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 2.770 sq. ft. (27.7 ft. x 100 ft.)

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subject property is currently improved with a three-story
      mixed-use building containing a retail unit at grade and four (4) residential units above.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is proposing to convert the ground floor
      retail unit to a residential unit, for a total of five (5) residential units at the subject property.

13.   Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to convert the ground floor retail unit to a residential unit, for a total of five (5) residential
      units at the subject property. The existing building's 28 ft. height dimension will remain
      without change. The existing building's footprint will also remain without change. No
      off-street parking is currently provided at the subject property. No new off-street parking
      is required for the proposed residential unit because the existing building is more than fifty
      (50) years old.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit wvv-w.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more infomiation). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

      YES              NO       X
